compute_alpharank: compute Alpha-Rank stationary distribution and fixation probabilities for a game given payoff tables
sweep_pi_vs_alpha: sweep stationary distribution across a range of selection intensities alpha for convergence analysis
sweep_pi_vs_epsilon: sweep infinite-AlphaRank stationary distribution across a range of noise perturbations epsilon
suggest_alpha: suggest an optimal alpha parameter for Alpha-Rank based on payoff gaps and desired tolerance
compute_and_report_alpharank: compute Alpha-Rank rankings and generate network visualization with printed strategy rankings
